授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
この科目では、心理学を人間と社会の問題に専念する科学として紹介します。社会科学、自然科学、人文科学からの実証的研究を組み込んだ学術的および応用的な分野です。 心理学者は、さまざまな実験、観察、調査を使用して、個人および社会的行動における精神機能の役割を理解しようとすると同時に、基礎となる生理学的および神経的プロセスを探求します。
この科目は、科学としての心理学の原則と主要な概念を学生に教えることを目的としています。 批判的思考の能力と、実証的研究の方法の基本的な理解に重点が置かれます。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
The course introduces psychology as a science devoted to human and social issues: an academic and applied discipline that incorporates empirical research from the social sciences, natural sciences, and humanities. Using a wide variety of experiments, observations, and surveys, psychologists attempt to understand the role of mental functions in individual and social behavior, while also exploring the underlying physiological and neural processes.
This course is designed to teach students the principles and main concepts of psychology as a science. Emphasis will be placed on the ability of critical thinking, and a basic understanding of the methods of empirical research.

head: 授業のテーマ
授業の内容（90分授業＝2時間）
事前/事後学修の内容
rows: General introduction; concept of psychology; practical organization
Psychology as a science; scientific principles
Independent variables, dependent variables, research design
Correlation versus causal relationship; usefulness and limits of surveys
Behaviorism, classical conditioning, operant conditioning, Donders' method
Classic studies by Asch, Milgram; contemporary versions
Biological psychology; studying psychology through studies of patients; neuroimaging
Visual system, dorsal/ventral processing, Gestalt psychology
Selective information processing, top-down vs. bottom-up
Positive, negative; parallel neural circuits; dopamine, serotonin
Negative feedback system; reinforcement; relation to biological needs and learning
Different types of learning, different types of memory
Higher-order cognition; language as a complex set of skills; symbolic processing, inference
Identity, role of culture in cognition, social dynamics
Participation in a behavioral science experiment in Prof. Lauwereyns's lab
